title: List of adjustable spectrum LED lights

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Adjustable spectrum LED lights are still relatively rare, which makes them difficult to find via web search on the topic, which is the only reason why we list them here. We are not affiliated with the companies, and we do not gain any ad profit from listing their products.

* $1000, Medic Grow, Spectrum X - https://medicgrow.com/products/spectrum-x-led-grow-light
* $1000, Sonofarm, Ultra X 900W - https://sonofarm.com/product/sonofarm-ultrax-growers-choice-luxx-lighting-gavita-1700-commercial-led-bar-grow-light-full-spectrum-dimmable-indoor-hydroponics-greenhouse-720-6500/
* $1200, Kessil, H1200 - https://kessil.com/science/H1200.php
* $1200, Optic LED, Slim 650S - https://opticledgrowlights.com/products/slim-650s-dimmable-led-grow-light-650w-uv-ir
* $1300, GrowSpec, GS Sunray 600 - https://growspec.pl/?p=1227
* $1300, Platinum LED, P1200 - https://platinumgrowlights.com/product/p1200/
* $1350, ThinkGrow, Model-H - https://www.thinkgrowled.com/#/modelh
* $1400, ECO Farm, ECO Farm ECOZ Pro, with touch screen - https://www.ecofarm.ca/products/eco-farm-ecoz-pro-700w-1000w-led-grow-light-strips-with-samsung-301h-chips-separately-uv-ir-control
* $1495, Scynce LED, Raging Kush 2.0 - https://scynceled.com/product/raging-kush-2/
* $1700, Kind LED, X² Commercial LED - https://www.kindledgrowlights.com/products/x2-commercial-led-grow-light
* $1900, California Light Works, SolarSystem® 1100 UVB - https://shop.californialightworks.com/products/solarsystem-1100-uvb
* $2400, Heliospectra, Heliospectra Dyna LED Grow Lights RX30 - https://www.heliospectra.com/led-grow-lights/dyna
* $2700, Grow-it-LED, Excalibur King PRO Series, with everything - https://grow-it-led.com/shop/led-grow-lights/excalibur-king-pro-series/excalibur-king-pro-series/
